pageDescription: Talk with the TutWithUs AI voice receptionist.
adminLoginDescription: Sign in to manage the trusted information used by your AI voice assistant.
adminSecurityNotice: Administrator access is restricted. Public account registration is disabled.
adminLoginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password, then try again.
adminSessionError: Unable to check administrator login. Please refresh and try again.
adminRequestError: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
adminIndexedSuccess: {name} was uploaded and saved as a draft.
adminRemovedSuccess: {name} was removed from the knowledge base.
adminBookingsDescription: Review and manage submitted booking requests.
adminEscalationsDescription: Claim and resolve requests that need a team member.
adminSettingsDescription: Save your changes as a draft, then activate the version you want used for new calls.
adminSettingsBasicsHelp: Name this version so your team can find it later, then set the opening greeting in each language.
adminSettingsEditorHelp: The fields below are filled from this saved version. Review the values, then save your changes.
adminSettingsInstructionsHelp: Add practical guidance for how the assistant should respond during calls.
adminSettingsCallHelp: Set a call time limit and provide the availability and follow-up guidance the assistant can share.
adminSettingsVersionsHelp: Drafts do not affect calls. Activate a version to use it for new calls; calls already in progress are unchanged.
adminUsersDescription: Manage workspace access and role assignments.
adminAuditDescription: Review administrative changes recorded in the system.
adminNoBookings: No booking requests match this view.
adminDraftNameHelp: An internal label for your team. It does not change what the assistant says.
adminGreetingHelp: The one-time opening words callers hear when a new call begins in this language.
adminInstructionTemplateHelp: Add extra guidance for calls. Built-in language, safety, one-greeting, noise-handling, and concise-answer rules still apply and override conflicting guidance.
adminVoiceHelp: Choose the voice callers will hear. Play a preview before selecting it.
adminMaxCallSecHelp: Calls end automatically after this amount of time.
adminBusinessHoursHelp: Hours the assistant can share when callers ask when your team is available.
adminEscalationMessage: When a caller needs more help
adminEscalationMessageHelp: What the assistant should tell callers when it cannot answer. This wording does not notify a team member or create a follow-up task.
adminDraftBasedOnVersion: A new draft is being prepared from version {version}. Saving will create a separate version.
adminConfirmDeleteDraft: Delete draft "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
adminConfirmDeleteVersion: Delete version "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
adminConfirmDeleteUser: Delete user {email}? This cannot be undone.
adminRoleHelpAdmin: Full access to all workspace areas, including user and audit management, settings, knowledge publishing, and booking and escalation controls.
adminRoleHelpEditor: Manage knowledge documents and submit them for administrator review. No access to other workspace areas.
adminRoleHelpAgent: View conversations and manage bookings and escalations. Contact details remain restricted.
adminRoleHelpViewer: Read-only access to conversations; cannot manage bookings, escalations, or workspace settings.
adminKnowledgeReviewNote: Only published content is used by the assistant. Check the facts, then select Publish. Editors can submit drafts for an administrator to publish.
adminConversationSelect: Select a conversation to view its transcript.
adminNoTranscript: No transcript was recorded for this conversation.
adminConversationDescription: Review consented calls and their retained transcripts.
adminManageDescription: Upload approved documents so your assistant can find and use their information.
adminFileRequirements: Up to 8 MB · PDF, DOCX, or text file
adminUploadPrivacy: Only upload material approved for the assistant. The original file and searchable passages are securely stored in the configured database.
adminUploadedDescription: Manage the source material currently available to the assistant.
adminNoDocuments: No documents yet. Upload approved material to build your knowledge base.
heading: How can we help?
description: Ask about our programs by voice, in Arabic, English or French.
privacyDescription: Your microphone stays off until you agree.
configLoadError: We couldn’t load the consent information. Check your connection and try again.
acknowledgeConsent: I understand this is an AI assistant.
microphoneUnsupported: This browser cannot access a microphone. Try a supported browser.
microphonePermissionDenied: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone access in your browser settings and try again.
microphoneUnavailable: No microphone is available. Connect a microphone and try again.
callConnectionError: We couldn’t connect the call. Your microphone has been stopped. Please try again.
transcriptSaveError: Some conversation text could not be saved. You can continue talking.
voiceServiceUnavailable: The voice service is unavailable right now. Your microphone has been stopped. Please try again later.
sessionEndError: Your microphone was stopped, but we couldn’t notify the service that the call ended.
accountCredentialsPairError: Enter both your phone number and member ID, or leave both empty for public information only.
accountCredentialsInvalid: The phone number and member ID did not match. Check both fields and try again.
accountVerificationUnavailable: Account verification is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
